services.title: Services
services.lead: We take on work that can launch in 1–6 weeks and show results right away.

items.title: Audit
items.for: When you are not sure where to start
items.short: We find where leads and money get lost.
items.text: We look at how your leads, sales and accounting work, show where money is lost and give you a plan with prices. The audit fee is credited to the project.
includes: Two meetings with you and your team

items.title: Websites
items.for: You need leads from the internet
items.short: A site in three languages that collects leads.
items.text: A website in Russian, Uzbek and English. It explains what you sell and collects leads.
includes: Set up in Google and Yandex

items.title: Telegram bots
items.text: The bot takes orders and bookings around the clock, accepts payment and notifies a manager.

items.title: CRM
items.text: We set up amoCRM or Bitrix24 around your sales process and train your team.
includes: Deal stages and tasks for managers

items.title: Analytics
items.short: Revenue and stock on one screen.
items.text: We bring data from 1C, Excel and your CRM into one screen that updates itself.

items.title: AI assistants
items.for: You answer the same questions all day
items.text: The assistant answers customers from your own materials and passes leads to a manager.
includes: Works in Telegram and on your site

faq.question: How much does a project cost?
faq.answer: We give an exact price after a short call and fix it in the contract.

faq.question: How do I pay?
faq.answer: 50% before work starts, 50% after acceptance. Bank transfer in UZS.

faq.question: How long until launch?
faq.answer: A website takes 1–2 weeks, a bot 2–4, CRM and analytics 3–6.

faq.question: What if I need changes after launch?
faq.answer: Bugs are fixed free for 30 days. After that, a support plan or hourly rate.

faq.question: Do you work outside Tashkent?
faq.answer: Yes, across Uzbekistan and abroad. We meet in Tashkent or online.

privacy.title: Privacy policy
privacy.description: How PLT GROUP handles data of visitors to pltgroup.uz.

sections.title: What data we receive
sections.text: When you send the request form, we receive the name, contact and task description you entered. They are kept in a protected system that only PLT GROUP staff can access. Then WhatsApp opens with a ready message. The site collects no other personal data.

sections.title: How we use it
sections.text: Only to reply to your request and prepare a proposal. We do not sell or share data with third parties.

sections.title: Third-party services
sections.text: The site loads fonts from Google Fonts and runs on Cloudflare. WhatsApp and Telegram apply their own rules.

sections.title: Deleting data
sections.text: Contact us through any channel on the site and we will delete our correspondence and data about your request.
